resale_co.name: Certificate of Re-occupancy (non-rental / resale)
resale_co.issued_by: Manchester Township Department of Inspections, Land Use & Planning
resale_co.lead_time: Standard inspections are scheduled by inspector availability; next-working-day inspection costs $300 and payment must be in by 3:00 p.m.
requirements: Smoke alarms and carbon monoxide alarms (the application is the Uniform Fire Code smoke and CO alarm certificate application)
Well certification if the home is on a well
Fireplace or chimney certification if there is a fireplace
Open permits must be listed; homes with open permits cannot use the accelerated fee
Email address required for notices; only the named contact person receives inspection information
The applicant must read, initial and sign the Township notice to homeowners, buyers, sellers and realtors

fees.label: Inspection, next working day (accelerated; not available with open permits; pay by 3:00 p.m.)
Reinspection when a smoke or CO alarm is deficient
fees.quote: Units deficient for a Smoke Alarm & Carbon Monoxide device will result in a $100 Re-inspection Fee

fees.label: Reinspection for a missed appointment or locked door
fees.quote: A Re-inspection fee of $50 will also be charged for missed appointments and locked doors at no fault of the inspector.

fees.label: Failed reinspection, additional fee
fees.quote: A failed re-inspection shall result in an additional $100.00 fee.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Apply and pay online through the Township's FastTrackGov citizen portal ('Apply for a Reoccupancy Inspection'), or complete Section A of the Non-Rental (resale) Re-occupancy application and pay by check payable to Manchester Township. All fees are non-refundable. Department of Inspections, Land Use & Planning, 1 Colonial Drive (Town Hall basement), Manchester, NJ 08759; 732-657-6700; building@manchestertwp.com; office hours 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. weekdays.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official / Electric Subcode Official / Fire Marshal

evidence.quote: Please be reminded that no dwelling unit may be occupied until a Certificate of Re-occupancy approval has been issued by this Department.
To All Homeowners, Residents, Buyers, Sellers, Realtors, & Builders
All payments must be received by 3:00 p.m. for a next day inspection whether in person or via our on-line citizen portal.
Please be reminded that no dwelling unit may be occupied until a Certificate of Re-occupancy approval has been issued by this Department.
Apply & Pay for your Business Licenses, Landlord Registration & Re-Occupancy Inspections Here!
Construction Official / Electric Subcode Official / Fire Marshal: Michael Martin ext 3902

resale_co.notes: Manchester runs one combined inspection: the Non-Rental (resale) Re-occupancy application is also the New Jersey Uniform Fire Code Certificate of Smoke Alarm and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Compliance application, so the fees above are charged once and are repeated under fire_cert. Michael Martin's extension is ext 3902 on 732-657-6700 per the Inspections Division staff directory. The Township's main number is 732-657-8121. Rentals use a separate Rental Re-occupancy application and landlord registration; that is not a sale rule. How long the certificate is valid is not stated.

requirements: Smoke alarms and CO alarms are checked in the Township Re-occupancy inspection; a deficient smoke or CO alarm means a $100 reinspection fee
The current application (revised 11-6-2025) does not list a fire extinguisher

fire_cert.notes: Manchester Township is its own fire code enforcing agency (LEA registry code M). The state directory lists Fire Official Michael P Martin, (732) 657-8121 (the Township main number), mmartin@manchestertwp.com, and 'Manchester Twp Insp' at 1 Colonial Dr, (732) 657-6700 for smoke detector compliance. The four fire companies (Manchester Emergency Services, Manchester Vol. Fire Co. #1, Ridgeway, Whiting) do not issue certificates.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: List any open permits on the application; homes with open permits cannot use the accelerated next-day inspection until the permits are closed.

other_items.label: Well and fireplace/chimney certifications
other_items.detail: The application asks whether a well certification and a fireplace/chimney certification are provided.

open_questions: How long the Certificate of Re-occupancy is valid, and whether the Township adds items beyond smoke and CO alarms at the resale inspection.
